verdict.rationale: The API documents a customer lookup endpoint keyed on a caller-provided external identifier, which returns a 308 Permanent Redirect to the canonical customer resource. That supports reconciling customer records against your own IDs. However, nothing shows that case records carry or can be queried by a stable external identifier, and the endpoint pages are only thin snippets. Missing for 10: external-identifier support for cases, documentation of how external identifiers are set and guaranteed unique or stable, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
